authorization: User explicitly authorized deletion of all current test media and controlled capture stop/start; requested at least half of disk free.
scope: Original database snapshot media only; newer IDs and creation dates preserved. Configurations, accounts, calibration assets and existing backups excluded.

cleanup.backup: Consistent database snapshot retained in Raspberry hybrid-backups; deleted media are not recoverable from this metadata backup.

recovery.private_capture_tmp: Released by service shutdown; no manual deletion of another service namespace.

limits: Point-in-time operational recovery, not a 24-hour stability test.
Automatic storage protection and retention estimate remain in development and are not deployed.
